responsibility: Holds the bulk of the vector-ALU portion of the GCN machine description. It defines the mode iterators and attributes used to generate large families of vector patterns, then describes expansions and insns for lane-wise arithmetic, reductions, DPP shuffle-based cross-lane operations, carries across multi-register vector values, and vector-construction helpers, providing the reusable pattern layer included by gcn.md for VALU-centric code generation.
